Complete your tables from [Activity 3](../activities/week-04-escape-room-schema.qmd), then insert, update, and delete data to test your schema. Submit your SQL, requested output or error messages, and short explanations. The assignment is worth **56 points**, including instructor checks of your tables.

[Download the assignment Word document](week-05-escape-room-data-changes.docx){download="week-05-escape-room-data-changes.docx" .btn .btn-primary}

The document contains the numbered questions and submission requirements. Submit your responses in Canvas; see Canvas for the due date.
